meta.note: Authored example proposals seeded from the source packet. None was implemented or tested. These are not correct answers.

seeds.title: A spoken reflection that shifts with the day
seeds.outcome: A short voice note whose emphasis changes with the day's activity.

middle.label: Local reviewed export and aggregation

seeds.dependency: A local reviewed export route, and a working voice quota and call.
why: Named in the source packet as a grounded combination.
A personal signal meets an output you can listen to, away from a screen.
unknown: No verified export route from Health to a local tool
Whether a spoken summary feels useful or creepy
seeds.test: Write one synthetic activity summary and one script by hand. Generate nothing yet: read it aloud and judge it.
seeds.success: You would want to hear tomorrow's.

local.title: A written reflection that never leaves the network
local.outcome: A local model drafts the reflection and you read it. The inventory holds no local voice, so the audio is lost.

middle.label: Local aggregation, then a local prompt

unknown: No verified export route from Health

apple-calendar.outcome: The reflection reads activity against what the calendar said the day would be: planned versus lived.

google-calendar.outcome: The reflection reads activity against what the calendar said the day would be: planned versus lived.

obsidian.outcome: Each reflection is kept as a note, so a month of them can be read back as a diary you never wrote.

spotify.outcome: The reflection ends with a track whose mood contrasts with the day, as a small provocation rather than a report.
spotify.adds: a soundtrack that argues with the numbers

reverse.title: Say it first, then watch the day answer
reverse.outcome: A spoken prompt in the morning, then a look at whether the evening aggregate moved. Nothing is written to the device.

middle.label: A person listens, moves or does not, then reads the aggregate

why: The arrow now runs from voice to body, and the only bridge is you.

seeds.title: Your legs hire a narrator
seeds.outcome: A nature-documentary voice describes your day as if you were a rare animal seen from a hide.

middle.label: Pick one number; write the line yourself

seeds.dependency: One hand-picked number and a voice call that works.
why: A deliberate mismatch of register: dry measurements in a dramatic voice.
unknown: Whether it stays funny on day three
seeds.test: Write three narrator lines for a made-up step count. Read them aloud to someone.
seeds.success: Somebody laughs, or you learn why they did not.

seeds.title: One unresolved decision at the end of the day
seeds.outcome: A physical closing ritual: at a local moment you chose, one open decision from a meeting appears.

middle.label: Retrieve one selected note, turn it into a local action

seeds.dependency: A note-to-action step and an approved trigger. No automatic messages or calendar writes.
why: Named in the source packet.
Text from a hosted record becomes something that happens in the room.
unknown: Which shortcuts exist on the home server
Whether Fathom notes can be selected this way
seeds.test: Choose one meeting and draft the action without running it.
seeds.success: You can say what you would have done differently tonight.

local.title: Copy the decision by hand into a local ritual
local.outcome: You paste one decision into a local shortcut yourself. Nothing is fetched from a hosted service.

middle.label: Your hands are the bridge

unknown: Whether copying by hand survives a busy week

apple-calendar.outcome: The decision appears in the first real gap after your last meeting rather than at a fixed hour.
apple-calendar.adds: a moment that moves with the day

elevenlabs.outcome: The room speaks the open decision aloud, once, in a voice you picked.

reverse.title: End the day by writing the question for tomorrow's meeting
reverse.outcome: A local ritual captures one question that you carry into the next meeting. It stays a personal note: nothing is sent into Fathom.

middle.label: You carry it

why: Fathom accepts nothing here, so the reversed arrow runs through a person.

seeds.title: A model disagreement exhibit
seeds.outcome: The same few examples, several readings side by side. You invent a use for the differences.

middle.label: A controlled benchmark runner

seeds.dependency: A runner, plus checking free access and rate limits before any call.
why: Named in the source packet.
Differences between models are treated as material rather than noise.
unknown: Which Free Endpoint cards this account can call
Whether a card's catalog ID is its inference ID
seeds.test: Define three questions and a comparison rubric before making any calls.
seeds.success: You can predict one disagreement before you see it.

local.title: A disagreement between local models
local.outcome: Two locally pulled models read the same examples. The range of voices is probably narrower.

middle.label: A loop over local models

unknown: Which models are pulled on the home server

elevenlabs.outcome: Each model's reading gets its own voice, so the exhibit becomes a short radio play of disagreement.

nous.outcome: A zero-price Nous candidate joins, so the exhibit spans two providers' habits rather than one catalog.

seeds.title: A new article meets an old note
seeds.outcome: One written guide connecting a fresh article to something you already care about.

middle.label: Retrieval, source acceptance and editorial selection

seeds.dependency: You choose the article and the note. An API key does not imply vault access.
why: Named in the source packet.
Outside evidence meets personal context.
unknown: A programmatic route into the vault
seeds.test: Make one short written guide using one article and one selected note.
seeds.success: The old note means something slightly different afterwards.

elevenlabs.outcome: A personal audio field guide: three minutes on a walk that connect a new article to an old note.

unsplash.outcome: The guide opens with one image chosen to disagree with the text.

seeds.title: The cloud proposes, the home server does
seeds.outcome: An agent proposes work in the cloud and asks a local worker for one bounded native task.

middle.label: An explicit job and result contract

seeds.dependency: Job schema, identity, permitted actions, idempotency, recovery and result checking.
why: Named in the source packet.
SSH reachability alone is not this system.
seeds.test: A proposed read-only job that returns executable availability, without adding a service.
seeds.success: A job fails on purpose and the record says why.

shortcuts.outcome: The bounded task becomes a native action on Apple hardware, which the Linux host could never do itself.

telegram.outcome: You approve each job from your phone before the home server runs it.

reverse.title: The home server asks the cloud to keep watch
reverse.outcome: The local machine hands a long, boring wait to a host that does not sleep, and reads the result in the morning.

middle.label: The same contract, in the other direction

why: Reversing shows which side needs to be reachable. A LAN host calling out needs no open port.

seeds.title: What could you observe in this gap?
seeds.outcome: A free moment becomes one concrete observation prompt. It stays a draft suggestion, with no calendar write.

middle.label: A rule matching time and context to a question

seeds.dependency: A research map that exists, and a matching rule.
why: Named in the source packet.
Time context is usually read for scheduling, seldom for curiosity.
unknown: Whether prompts are welcome in a free moment
seeds.test: Draft three prompts for an existing gap. Do not create events.
seeds.success: You actually do one of them.

local.title: The same prompt from the native calendar
local.outcome: Apple Calendar supplies the gap through the local script, so the matching stays on your machines.

middle.label: A local matching rule

seeds.title: A personal image becomes a memory cue
seeds.outcome: One photo you chose becomes a visual explanation for a question you are following.

middle.label: Selection, transformation and narrative judgement

seeds.dependency: Explicit selection of one non-private image.
why: Named in the source packet.
seeds.test: Use one explicitly selected non-private image and draft two interpretations.
seeds.success: You remember the question a week later because of the picture.

seeds.title: A deliberate manual export
seeds.outcome: You export a selection by hand, review it and import it. No automatic route is implied.

middle.label: A manual export you review

seeds.dependency: An export format and an importer, neither of which is established.
why: The direct route is explicitly unverified, so the only honest bridge is a person doing it once.
seeds.test: List the columns you would want. Export nothing yet.
seeds.success: You can name the one column you actually need.

seeds.title: A narrated recap for a client
seeds.outcome: A short recap in a licensed voice, built from notes the client has approved for reuse.

middle.label: Rewrite and permission check

seeds.dependency: Client permission, and a plan with commercial licensing.
why: The published plan adds commercial licensing, which is what this outcome needs.
unknown: Whether the current plan already includes it
seeds.test: Check the plan page, then narrate one invented recap.
seeds.success: You would send it without an apology.

seeds.title: A persistent agent on an included route
seeds.outcome: The agent uses included paid-model routes within daily, weekly and monthly limits.

middle.label: Paid access enabled on the account

seeds.dependency: The account currently reports paid access false. A measured bottleneck should come first.
why: Removes a named gate, but is worth it only if a zero-price model has failed a real task.
unknown: Whether any zero-price model is enough
seeds.test: Try one zero-price candidate first and write down what it could not do.
seeds.success: You can name the task that needs the paid route.

seeds.title: What can a zero-price model not do?
seeds.outcome: Before paying, find the real edge of the five zero-price candidates.

middle.label: A small task list and a written verdict

seeds.dependency: A zero-price entry that answers. Other limits may apply.
why: Five entries have zero prompt and completion prices. That is a candidate, not a test.
seeds.test: Write the three tasks first. Run nothing yet.
seeds.success: You have a task list you would use on any model.

seeds.title: A few articles become linked notes
seeds.outcome: Three chosen pages become readable notes. You keep only the passages you would quote.

middle.label: Your selection of passages

seeds.dependency: A route into the vault, or pasting by hand.
why: The free allowance covers small prototypes.
seeds.test: Convert three chosen URLs and keep only the passages you would quote.
seeds.success: You link one passage to an existing note.

seeds.title: A larger monthly reading sweep
seeds.outcome: Many more pages per month. This is more of the same, not a new capability.

middle.label: A list of pages and a filter

seeds.dependency: Evidence that a working prototype hit the free limit.
why: Listed as an alternative. It buys volume and concurrency.
seeds.test: First show the free allowance is the real limit.
seeds.success: You can show a month where the limit stopped you.

seeds.title: What did three readers hear in the same meeting?
seeds.outcome: One anonymised transcript, read by several models. Where they diverge may show what the meeting left unclear.

middle.label: Anonymise, then a fixed prompt

seeds.dependency: Permission to reuse the transcript, and access to more than one endpoint.
why: Disagreement between readers can be a signal about the source.
unknown: Which endpoints this account can call
seeds.test: Write the fixed prompt and predict the disagreement. Call nothing.
seeds.success: You find a question you should have asked in the meeting.

swaps.label: Use a public Free Endpoint voice card (magpie-tts-zeroshot)
swaps.loss: Voice quality and rights unknown; still hosted
swaps.unknown: The card is not matched to the public ID list; account access untested

swaps.label: Use a local model on the home server
swaps.gain: Data stays on the network; no rate limit from a provider
swaps.loss: Fewer and smaller models; less disagreement to observe
swaps.unknown: Daemon not verified; models pulled unknown

swaps.label: Use a local model on the home server
swaps.unknown: Daemon not verified; models pulled unknown

swaps.label: Fetch a page you already found
swaps.gain: Whole pages rather than search results
swaps.loss: You have to find the URL yourself

swaps.label: Use the other meeting record
swaps.gain: Connector shown as installed and enabled

swaps.label: Use the other meeting record
swaps.gain: A second record of the same habit

swaps.label: Use the native calendar
swaps.gain: Runs on the home server; no vendor connector in the path
swaps.loss: Depends on a script that has not been run

swaps.label: Run the worker at home
swaps.gain: Native Apple tools; data stays on the network
swaps.loss: Sleeps, moves and loses power with your home
swaps.unknown: The agent's provider on the home server has no identified default model

swaps.label: Use the editor's transcript
swaps.loss: Heavier workflow for a single voice note
